description.value: Seafair Smoke & Mixer is a Richmond neighbourhood institution with over 40 years of community service, specializing in an extensive selection of premium Cuban and non-Cuban cigars, loose tobacco, and a full range of vape devices, disposables, and e-liquids from brands such as ELF BAR, ALLO, and VUSE. Beyond tobacco, the shop functions as a local convenience stop and offers FedEx and Neighbour Express parcel drop-off and pick-up services. It is located in a strip-mall unit on No 1 Road in the Seafair area of Richmond.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at seafairsmoke.com is live, detailed, and clearly describes an active business, confirming it is open. The site focuses exclusively on tobacco, cigars, and vape products, with only a passing reference to 'convenience items'; no cycling amenities such as bike parking, water refill, or food are mentioned anywhere, so all amenity fields default to null. A name discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Seafair Smoke & Mixers' (plural) while the website consistently uses 'Seafair Smoke & Mixer' (singular).
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Seafair Smoke & Mixers' (plural) while the website consistently uses 'Seafair Smoke & Mixer' (singular).
Address format inconsistency within the website itself: footer shows '9-8671 No 1 Rd' while the contact page shows '8671 No 1 Rd #9'; used the contact-page format as the clearer primary value.

Business is primarily a tobacco/cigar/vape specialty shop; 'convenience items' is mentioned in carousel text but no food or grocery products are listed anywhere on the site, so Basic groceries could not be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible convenience/smoke shop in Richmond; a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking convenience items or parcel services.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags shop=convenience and the website describes the business as a stop for 'convenience items' alongside its primary tobacco/cigar/vape focus; the Groceries category is a loose but defensible fit for a convenience-tagged shop.

wow_evidence: Richmond neighbourhood institution with over 40 years of community service
